title: Remote proxy transcript: reconcile positions when the Mac inserts before the hydrated window, so a shifted tail never writes an existing message id at a new position
outcome: Remote proxy transcript: reconcile positions when the Mac inserts before the hydrated window, so a shifted tail never writes an existing message id at a new position
acceptance: When the upstream session gains a message before the proxy's hydrated window and the window's tail shifts by one or more positions, the proxy's next persist writes no row whose (session_id, message_id) already exists at another position, and the proxy's transcript matches upstream order

A regression test drives the real remote proxy path with the insert-before-window, shifted-tail shape (the shape of the evidence run test-9ae427c1, evidence commit 171e7b5d) and passes; on the pre-fix code it fails with the UNIQUE messages.session_id, messages.message_id error
No change to isolation semantics of a failed session write; a persist conflict in one proxy session still never rolls back other sessions' writes
